mapper.sql: SELECT schedule_id, department_id, doctor_id, visit_date, period, start_time, end_time, total_quota, remaining_quota, version, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM clinic_schedule
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO clinic_schedule (department_id, doctor_id, visit_date, period, start_time, end_time, total_quota, remaining_quota, version, status, remark, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{departmentId}, #{doctorId}, #{visitDate}, #{period}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{totalQuota}, #{remainingQuota}, 0, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE clinic_schedule SET remaining_quota = remaining_quota - 1, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND status = 'OPEN' AND remaining_quota > 0
UPDATE clinic_schedule SET remaining_quota = remaining_quota + 1, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND remaining_quota < total_quota
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM clinic_schedule WHERE schedule_id IN #{id}
